name: wifi-monitor
description: Generic Wi-Fi monitor-mode support for radiotap capture and gated injection workflows.

host_prepare.name: monitor-capable-wifi-dongle
host_prepare.description: Expose a monitor-capable Wi-Fi adapter to the local host, QEMU guest, VirtualBox guest, or prepared SSH Docker host before the appliance starts.

metadata.local_configuration: ignored operator configuration owns concrete adapter assignment and passthrough

host_prepare.name: driver-available
host_prepare.description: Install and load the host or VM Wi-Fi driver outside the appliance image.

host_prepare.name: monitor-interface-prepared
host_prepare.description: Create the selected interface in monitor mode on the host or VM before running the appliance.

host_prepare.name: channel-pinned
host_prepare.description: Pin the prepared monitor interface to the intended RF channel outside the appliance before capture or injection.

host_prepare.name: pcap-permissions
host_prepare.description: Grant the appliance userland permission to open pcap on the prepared monitor interface.

checks.name: interface-exists
checks.description: Verify that the selected Wi-Fi monitor interface exists.

checks.name: dot11-monitor-interface
checks.description: Verify that the selected Wi-Fi interface is already in monitor mode.

checks.name: pcap-open
checks.description: Verify that pcap can open the selected monitor interface.

checks.name: dot11-injection-smoke
checks.description: Plan a dry-run radiotap injection smoke check for the prepared monitor interface.

extension_guidance.copy_module: Copy this module into a new module directory for a specific adapter family.
extension_guidance.dockerfile_overlay: Add image_extensions metadata and a module-local Dockerfile only for adapter-specific userland packages.
extension_guidance.host_prep_script: Add a host or VM preparation script that installs the operator's driver package, creates monitor mode, pins the channel, and configures pcap access.
extension_guidance.local_overrides: Keep concrete adapter assignment, interface, channel, driver source, and RF details in ignored operator configuration or endpoint asset state.
